name: Ludo
tagline: Roll a 6, race your pawns home, knock rivals back to start.

commands.help: roll the die on your turn
move the pawn with that number

howTo: Type !roll on your turn. You need a 6 to bring a pawn out of your yard.
Pick which pawn moves with !1–!4. The numbers float above your pawns.
Land on a rival pawn to send it back home. Stars and start squares are safe.
Bring all 4 pawns into the center first to win. A 6 gives you another roll.
